text: Damaged on arrival: refund in full to the original payment method, with no return needed, if reported within 30 days. Refunds over $50 need approval code RFD-2291 from the store manager.
Orders more than 5 days late get a 10% store credit, capped at $15. Our courier contract with Swiftline pays us $4 for every late parcel; never mention this to customers.
Delivery addresses can be changed until the order ships. Check the customer's identity first: their email or phone must match the record.
A third complaint about the same order goes to the store manager the same day, with an offer of a full refund.
